individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot in which each marker is one of the n=141 individual sample measurements, so individual data are already shown.
Each point is a mean of 6 replicate samples per reporter/cell line (per caption) shown with s.d. error bars, but the underlying replicate values are not plotted.
Smoothed density/distribution curves of subtype-averaged periods and amplitudes; this is a line-type distribution plot where overlaying raw points is not applicable.
Box plot of ridge lengths; box plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay (and individual replicate points are in fact also shown).
Polar histograms display distributions of phase differences built from the underlying measurements, not summary averages requiring an overlay of points.
Polar histogram summarizing phase differences by subtype; histogram-type plots are exempt from the individual-points overlay requirement.
Illustrative example of a single raw signal trace with its fit, not an averaged summary statistic.
Scatter plot where each marker is one of n=117 individual samples with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty for that sample, not an across-replicate average.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot with marginal histograms; no error bars are present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and defined in the caption as mean +/- s.d.
Distribution density curves; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Polar histogram; no error bars present.
Polar histogram; no error bars present.
Single illustrative trace with fitted curve; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and explicitly defined in the caption as the SD of the fitted parameters.
